newsitem.title: FINLAND: AT&T to sell Finnish Telecom software in Asia.
newsitem.headline: AT&T to sell Finnish Telecom software in Asia.

text.p: Finnish state-owned telecoms operator Telecom Finland said in a statement on Friday it had agreed with AT&T Online Services, part of U.S. AT&T Corp, that AT&T would distribute its electronic gateway software in Asia.
"AT&T will market systems to business users to serve as a corporate gateway which will link the users to the world wide network services of AT&T," Telecom Finland said.

EDISERVER, marketed by Telecom Finland since 1990, is the corporate gateway market leader in Europe and France, it said. The software delivers and translates business transactions over the Internet into formats preferred by recipients. @ --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
